notes: Endpoints: the committed multi-file OpenAPI specs (public/openapi/read.yaml for /api/*, write.yaml for /api/v3 with servers /api/v3; path items are $ref to other files, which from-openapi now follows), scope = the files that register those APIs (src/routes/write/, api.js, admin.js). Nothing comes out right: the write API registers through a helper, setupApiRoute(router, 'post', '/x', mws, handler), and the read API through setupPageRoute(app, '/x', ...) which also creates the /api twin (custom-registrar, 365); admin.js builds paths from a parameter, router.get(`/api/${name}/config`) (prefix-as-param, 13); api.js does const router = express.Router(); app.use('/api', router) in the same function and the routes still come out without /api (mount-same-scope, 12). The precision sample (whole repo) adds: jQuery $.get(url, callback) in the browser code is taken for a route registration (call-taken-for-route).
